crossRefs.note: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.
Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.
Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
“How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes…
“Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
“Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.’ “Behold, I will judge you, because you say…

translations.web: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?
translations.bsb: Since I am already found guilty, why should I labor in vain?
translations.kjv: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
translations.asv: I shall be condemned; Why then do I labor in vain?
